component.name: mistral.rs (CPU)
component.summary: Run local language models with the CPU

description.p: A community package of the unmodified official mistral.rs CPU Linux build for local language model inference, an OpenAI-compatible API and a browser chat interface. Model weights have their own licenses.

The desktop entry starts a server in a terminal and downloads HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct on first use. Open http://127.0.0.1:1234/ui in your browser. Stop the server with Ctrl+C. Models, credentials and CLI state use private persistent app storage. CPU and CUDA editions use separate caches and default ports.

Pass explicit CLI arguments after flatpak run io.github.EricLBuehler.MistralRs.CPU, for example: serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 1234 -m Qwen/Qwen3-4B. Interactive and one-shot inference use the run subcommand. Explicit serve commands should include --host 127.0.0.1 to keep the API local.
This edition uses CPU inference and does not need GPU access.

Host model folders are optional: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/models:ro io.github.EricLBuehler.MistralRs.CPU. Then pass the model path with -f. Remove overrides with flatpak override --user --reset io.github.EricLBuehler.MistralRs.CPU.
Host toolchains, Python packages and external command tools are not included. Agent workflows that require host tools or nested sandboxing are outside this package's supported features.
